pr.title: Fix search saying No items yet. when nothing matches

lenses.note: Bug fix with a clear single design; the change matches the PR's words. The empty-table-with-search case keeps 'No items yet.', which the PR states.
No spec file in this change.

Three new tests cover no match, escaping, and an empty table. They would fail against the old code (the first two). A beforeEach in test/apply-migrations.js resets data, so the DELETE does not leak. I could not run them because vitest is not installed here.
The diff touches no docs files.
The message is escaped, the extra COUNT query runs only when a search finds nothing, and I found no defects.
The search term is HTML-escaped in the new message, and a test covers it. The count query has no user input.
The diff touches no UI style or layout files; it changes one message string in the server-rendered HTML.
No browser or UI flow is available in this session, and the PR says so.
The title is under 72 characters and the claims match the diff. The 'new tests failed before the fix' claim is plausible, but I did not run it.
